propositions: An optional isolated backfill adapter must extract and classify error signatures from local Claude Code session transcripts to reconstruct environment and integration diagnostics, with deterministic keyword/regex classification (no LLM call) and output labeled source=backfill_classified, confidence=classified.

The adapter module must define a classification enum with exactly five values (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) and a JSON schema with kind, signature, ts, source, and confidence fields.
Core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py) must NOT import the claude_transcripts adapter, enforcing portability and preventing the adapter from affecting the main rebar metrics command.

The backfill script scripts/backfill_transcripts.py must execute a targeted error-signature grep pass over transcript JSONL, route matched patterns through the deterministic classifier, and emit classified interval records with the prescribed schema and labels.

Unit tests must verify adapter classification correctness on fixture transcripts (known signatures → correct enum values), schema compliance, zero network/LLM calls, and that a clean transcript yields no output.
The backfill script itself must be integration-tested by invoking its entry point over a fixture transcript directory and asserting it emits correctly labeled classified records.
